title: /run/context.json
description: What a plugin's run is told, in the file /run/context.json of its container, read only. Plugins are a feature still being built, so this is not contract until the release that ships them. It names nothing of a person, and nothing of a capability the run is not given: head with product outside a call, model with model in a refresh only (a hook and a call have none), pr in a hook, tool in a call, whose arguments are in /run/call.json beside this file. The writer is console/core/src/plugin/run.rs; its tests hold what it writes to this schema.

kind.description: refresh: the default branch's head, or a run on demand. hook: a run on a pull request a cycle left. call: one call of a tool, whose answer is what it writes to stdout.

trigger.description: What started the run: the tick saw the default branch move, a person on the host, a press of the view's button, a cycle that left a pull request, a chat that called a tool, or an outside agent that called one through the MCP server.

commit.description: The plugin's own commit, the pin's.

head.description: The commit checked out in /product. Only with product.

model.description: Only with model: the id to send to /run/tehas/model.sock and the run's budget of tokens.

tool.description: Only in a call: the id of the tool called.

pr.description: Only in a hook: the pull request, and the commits of its base and its head.
